coordinate_system.orientation_notes: Use the front-view convention: world Z follows the sleeve axis and world XY is the end-view plane. Treat section_aa's longitudinal X designation as a view-local axial coordinate. The supplied cut-normal labels are inconsistent between views, so a complete signed transformation between their local coordinate frames is not established. No datum-based origin is defined.

features.name: Central bore
features.description: Central cylindrical bore visible on end face, specified with diameter 20.15 to 20.45 mm for a minimum length of 14 mm at both ends.

features.name: End Stepped Journals
features.description: Reduced cylindrical OD step located at each end of the component.

features.name: Outer blend radius R6.50
features.description: Convex transition radius blending into the 40° chamfer at both ends of the component.

geometry.position_description: At the outer transition to the 40° chamfer

features.name: 40° end chamfer
features.description: Conical bevel/chamfer angled at 40° to the horizontal axis, typical at both ends.

geometry.position_description: Connects R6.50 outer radius to R2.00 transition fillet

features.name: Internal transition fillet R2.00
features.description: Concave fillet radius between the 40° chamfer and the adjacent horizontal surface, typical at both ends.

geometry.position_description: At the junction of the 40° chamfer and the horizontal surface

features.name: Overall Component Body
features.description: Hollow symmetrical tubular sleeve component with stepped outer diameter, central barrel section, and contoured internal cavity.

features.name: Central Outer Diameter Section
features.description: Central cylindrical body section with flat length of 73.50 mm and ground or turned surface finish.

relationships.detail: The longitudinal section shows the internal passage and central external cylinder sharing the sleeve axis.
The end-entry bores and reduced end journals share the component axis.
The central external cylinder and both reduced end journals form the coaxial stepped exterior shown in the longitudinal section.
The detail explicitly describes the outer blend radius joining the end chamfer.
The detail explicitly places the transition fillet at the junction between the chamfer and the adjacent horizontal surface.

datum_scheme.datum_hierarchy_notes: No datum definitions or datum-referenced GD&T controls are supplied. A-A identifies a section cut, not a datum.

assumptions.text: Grouped front_view:F1 with section_aa:F4 using the explicit A-A cut linkage and the section's description of the same end entries within the continuous internal passage. Selected front_view:F1 as canonical because its entry-bore callouts are intact, whereas section_aa reports cropping of those callouts.

Used section_aa:F4 for depth_condition because the longitudinal cut establishes a through passage. The front-view STEPPED classification describes the changing internal profile rather than a blind termination; the minimum entry-length callout is not interpreted as total passage depth.

Retained the paired-entry multiplicity from front_view:F1 within the merged internal-passage feature. The entries have no separately defined datum identities or positions requiring individual feature nodes.

Interpreted front_view:F2 as the end-journal observation identified in section_aa:F3. The A-A section and matching end-step identification resolve the front view's explicitly uncertain counterbore classification; section_aa:F3 is canonical because it establishes the external surface and axial extent.

Kept detail_x:F1, detail_x:F2, and detail_x:F3 as separate singleton feature definitions with their stated repeated-end scope. The DETAIL X marker on section_aa:F3 identifies the shoulder region being enlarged, not identity between the cylindrical journal and each radius or chamfer.

Chose the front-view Z-axis convention for the assembled coordinate system and treated section_aa's conflicting axis labels as view-local coordinates. No datum origin or unsupported signed coordinate transformation was introduced.

Created no unattached-callout resolutions because no dimension_callouts_unattached entries were supplied. The partial callout mentioned only in front_view extraction_notes is already represented by the attached journal-length callout in section_aa:F3.
The transition between the 20.15–20.45 mm end-entry bores and the larger internal cavity is a square, perpendicular shoulder with no specified radius or taper.
Untoleranced dimensions are assumed to follow the ISO 2768-m (medium) general dimensional tolerance specification, governing all untoleranced linear, radius, and angular dimensions.
